description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, Lathliss and Cloudstone Curio triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
